title: Student Growth to Portfolio Network
placeholder: Click any stage to see what flows into it and where that data goes next.

nodes.label: Session Observations
detail: What it holds
A mentor's in-session notes on what a student attempted.
Flows into
Student growth metrics, once aggregated across sessions.

nodes.label: Student Growth Metrics
detail: What it holds
Aggregated measurements of a student's progress over time.
Flows into
Skill mastery tracking, once classified by skill level.

nodes.label: Skill Mastery Tracking
detail: What it holds
The emerging, practising, or mastered level for each specific skill.
Flows into
The digital portfolio, once evidenced by uploaded work.

nodes.label: Digital Portfolio System
detail: What it holds
The actual saved work evidencing that mastery -- photographs, code, project files.
Flows into
The parent portal, exposed read-only to one family.

nodes.label: Parent Access Portal
detail: What it holds
One family's scoped, view-only window into everything to its left.
Where it goes next
Nowhere. It is a leaf: the portal shows, it does not feed anything back.
